bundle.description: Topo, 2023 aerial imagery, 1 m LiDAR relief and contours, LiDAR bush and shooting lanes, forest stands with cuts and burns, lakes, wetlands, forest roads, the ZEC boundary, and the habitat, wind and going grids, for the ground west of Lac Bailey; full detail within 5 km of the shared spot.

forest.vintage: 4th inventory (2012 photos), with 5th-inventory stands from 2023-24 photos (preliminary) in the south and east; cuts, burns and outbreaks to 2023

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

satellite.source: Imagerie_GQ WMTS, MRNF: the 20 cm ortho

hillshade.missing: not baked: the map shades the relief from the DEM

hillshadeLidar.source: HRDEM 1 m LiDAR DTM, NRCan: QC-600023_29_LacAuBrochet_MTM7_2023-1m, gaps filled from QC-600015_24_LidarDIF_Cote_Nord_MTM7_2015_17-1m

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, with HRDEM 1 m LiDAR over the core (QC-600023_29_LacAuBrochet_MTM7_2023-1m, gaps filled from QC-600015_24_LidarDIF_Cote_Nord_MTM7_2015_17-1m), NRCan

contours.source: HRDEM 1 m LiDAR DTM, NRCan: QC-600023_29_LacAuBrochet_MTM7_2023-1m, gaps filled from QC-600015_24_LidarDIF_Cote_Nord_MTM7_2015_17-1m

forest.source: Carte écoforestière (MRNF), with later cuts, burns and outbreaks laid over
forest.vintage: 4th inventory (2012 photos), with 5th-inventory stands from 2023-24 photos (preliminary) in the south and east; cuts, burns and outbreaks to 2023

understory.source: MRNF LiDAR 2023_LacAuBrochet_LiDAR, flown 2024-07-27; MRNF LiDAR 2023_RiviereAuxOutardes_LiDAR, flown 2024-09-06 to 2024-09-14; heights above the tiles' own ground returns

lanes.source: MRNF LiDAR 2023_LacAuBrochet_LiDAR, flown 2024-07-27; MRNF LiDAR 2023_RiviereAuxOutardes_LiDAR, flown 2024-09-06 to 2024-09-14; heights above the tiles' own ground returns

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

bathySheets.missing: Ontario only: MNR lake survey sheets

places.source: TRQ territories, the carte écoforestière's burns and AQréseau roads, MRNF

wmu.missing: not in the maps: the hunting zones' only source (SmartFaune) states no licence, so the area file names the zone instead

camps.missing: Ontario only: Crown land camps come from LIO

crown.missing: Ontario only: Crown land comes from LIO

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake bathymetry comes from LIO

fire.source: Burns from the carte écoforestière (ca_feu), MRNF

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

depth.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns; bush from the LiDAR point cloud where it was measured
habitat.note: stand height and closure from the LiDAR point cloud over 100% of the core

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads
